name: mc_status
title: Server status
description:
Reports plugin and Paper versions, online player count, queued build operations, the current per-tick build budget (it shrinks while the server is busy), uptime and whether the connection to the plugin is live.

WHEN TO USE: at the start of a session or after a "cannot reach the plugin" error (the connection retries in the background, so a retry a few seconds later is often enough); before a very large build, to see the queue; when asked whether the server is up.
WHEN NOT TO USE: for world data (mc_survey, mc_inspect). Not in a loop while a build runs: the build reply reports its own result.

PARAMETERS: none.

SIDE EFFECTS: read-only. If the plugin is unreachable, the error says why (wrong token, plugin down, network).
